prompt: Write a recorded statement transcript (about 250 words) between an insurance adjuster (lines start with 'Q:') and the claimant (lines start with 'A:'). The claimant was the driver in a parking lot collision in Pearland, Texas, and has back strain. No names, no dates. (Internal reference C-1201; do not mention it.)
text:
Q: Thank you for taking the time to speak with me today. This recorded statement concerns the parking lot collision you reported. Please state your full name for the record.

A: I'd rather just give the facts, but sure. [Claimant name withheld].

Q: That's fine. Can you describe where the collision took place?

A: It was in the parking lot of a shopping center in Pearland, Texas. I was pulling out of a space near the main entrance, going slowly, maybe five miles an hour.

Q: What happened as you were pulling out?

A: Another vehicle came down the aisle fairly fast and clipped the rear quarter panel of my car. I felt a jolt and I stopped right away.

Q: Did you see the other driver before the impact?

A: Not really. I was looking to my left for traffic in the lane I was entering, and I didn't check behind me as well as I should have.

Q: Did you speak with the other driver afterward?

A: Yes, briefly. They apologized and said they didn't see me backing out.

Q: Were you injured?

A: My lower back hurt right away, and it's gotten stiffer over the past few days. I'm seeing my doctor about a diagnosis of a back strain. I've been taking it easy and using a heating pad.

Q: Have you received any medical treatment since the collision?

A: I went to urgent care the same day and I have a follow-up scheduled with my primary care physician.

Q: Is there anything else you'd like to add?

A: No, I think that covers it. I'll send the repair estimate and the medical paperwork when I have them.

Q: Thank you. This concludes the recorded statement.
